### Common Food Group Examples

- **Grains & starches:** 1 slice of bread, ½ cup cooked rice or pasta, or 1 small pancake (about the size of a CD).
- **Vegetables:** 1 cup raw leafy greens, ½ cup other raw or cooked vegetables, or ½ cup vegetable juice.
- **Fruit:** 1 small piece of fruit (about the size of a fist or baseball), ½ cup chopped/canned fruit, or ½ cup to 1 cup 100% juice.
- **Protein (meat, poultry, fish, beans):** 2 to 3 ounces cooked meat, poultry, or fish (about the size of a deck of cards), or ½ cup cooked beans or lentils.
- **Dairy:** 1 cup milk or yogurt, or 1½ ounces cheese (about the size of a small matchbox).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF15p7DFPfAfuBc3uVGi3xH-V1lV096PJodf9ntbU_Izgl-RsGq3i4hOLgR4Vp6Dp2vQw1RUtk5KxVzQVYxhmrkyMPlLHd3SElmX0-epUYWRMDVLw-vG3jrRarqpoAQqi_XpuWey36cmgZD_NGQHQtVDuJNgP6YogtoxhvWQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1wUurnRpiXkohckx9bA8Gbnk_FlCrcWelWBd4UH56_wWtZKSCL-rRuF-8hx6lXuvjLVTBGziY8Vr26tUEJvAd8ddwbr88tD78-kQRlfjJ3XLcnXI7SjugGle2l11VH5PfxWGWlfsMb99Z7sbf8zgtbMNJGu-yjFBHm6PmPMMgPjU5g)[[3]](https://study.com/academy/lesson/video/serving-size-definition-examples.html)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrgEBxCJF1xuo5ZBTvdJvuuJ0aPMzXFwudwwBOLJhNO3TQXwtNuQ8Q1bhaAF3tTcnM_x6kBdDHdrSiJLI1J-u-_YMMO2kfXCEcq8h3tBk23cqccZhaDFh-7sWxwS19ob2Cfln7jbZb_f9Elw_cHe66ToBw7DMZ_CPrHPvJES0Q6S3kkmo4qO-NKU3yo3qv0s8fINUOVrr9O5fNfmv91CIjalELLpaGzqomerngWFAqDk)

### Serving Size vs. Portion Size

- **Serving size:** A standardized measurement used on food labels or in nutrition guides.
- **Portion size:** The actual amount of food you choose to eat or are served at one time, which may be multiple servings.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF186uju6HYUo9x-NG6N-m6yp-kXhd4jn4ambQTJBmb7KZtxuq7IpTtISCDqVwXlKv3JI9nKtkecJkz45wb8uSda4kLzpXN4Z1qxTsZnFZZKw1eaWAojNR9EDz6Tps-AUhWZsvGPnPRVRGPpAHkPFnF0ya7nyT-HpDSKBsiT9h4jVrBIu6Xx0TdqSH)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3DrArxaB6ls)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXUIPpXtoULzLLYBpXQfM2Zj8MaWDI8Xq_aAv-6lh7ooOHAbMGN8VKUWn2pdwWqctqc_mwSGZlNnUtVkw6rPM2PKm7AX7PTeqBo-dF608um9VGv1txnv95nBvHJcT1WLq8vSiYyldjNHdHxRbRuS1zCGE)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStgEBxCJF15iLGU31RrD_EFfnpufcjZWXcA3nHEuA2nJD_ThP8thIg8-6aKz_SpZXLl7vn0U2DPkyM7qAXExLXIOJEPXYlrfUuUPBUuEx1DvPmJ8WFYC5lKumYIrWTbZmczrnWNjPZArOJm5TOLvCChYtaKcdLJUgU5b0KZ4H3ZXHKVms8ge9Nzuv09rktX9dSHcI1gZ-klvROw_pWhwTEo8QgXXc62zqAT2I3WZ1K2UT1c6RPy7Ebw)
